title: Product Designer (m/f/d) — Energy Insights
description: What we are building ecoplanet gives industrial companies the kind of energy management a corporate energy department would provide, without needing one of their own. We work with German Mittelstand manufacturers in plastics, metals, and food production, helping them see where their energy goes, catch problems when they happen, and act on what they find. Our platform covers meter data, consumption monitoring, efficiency analysis, compliance, and energy procurement. We're a Series A company backed by EQT Ventures and HV Capital. Why This Role Matters You'll be the designer on our Energy Insights team. The team owns our core entry product: 24/7 consumption monitoring, alerting, and the insights that turn load profiles into decisions a customer can act on. Your work covers the whole customer journey, from onboarding and labelling a customer's meters, to surfacing findings they can trust, to making sure they come back regularly. You'll be the only designer on this team, working directly with a PM, engineers, and our customer success team. Much of the work is improving and reshaping features we already have, so you'll be making existing things clearer and more useful as well as designing new ones. What You’ll Achieve Own design for the Energy Insights product end to end: research, flows, interaction design, and polished UI Redesign existing features, such as the customer cockpit, monitoring views, alerts, and findings, so energy managers can go from "something's off" to "here's what to do" quickly Design data-dense interfaces (load profiles, consumption breakdowns, anomalies) that stay readable for people who aren't data analysts Shape onboarding and labelling flows that help customers describe their meters and production so our insights improve over time Design internal tools for our customer success and onboarding teams. They're users too. Talk to customers regularly and turn what you learn into design decisions Help build and maintain a pragmatic design system that fits how we ship What Sets You Up for Success Must have: B2B product design experience — you've designed complex software for professional users, not only consumer apps A portfolio showing data-heavy, workflow-driven product work, and the reasoning behind it Comfort working as a solo designer: you set your own process, make calls without waiting for sign-off, and know when "good enough to learn from" beats "perfect" An early-stage mindset — priorities shift as we learn, and you treat ambiguity as something to work through, not around Strong interaction and visual design skills; fluent in Figma Willingness to talk to users directly and bring evidence into design discussions Clear communication in English; German at a professional working level, since most of our customers operate in German and you'll need to understand their feedback directly Nice to have: Experience with industrial, manufacturing, energy, IoT, or other operational software Familiarity with time-series data, dashboards, or monitoring and alerting products Some front-end understanding — enough to work closely with engineers on feasibility and detail How You’ll Grow As the sole designer on a core product team, you'll set the design practice for Energy Insights largely on your own terms — there's no senior designer above you dictating process. You'll work closely enough with customers and engineers to see the direct consequences of your decisions, and as the product and team grow, you'll have the option to shape whether and how a design function scales beyond you. What You Get Real ownership: your designs define how industrial customers experience the product Direct impact on a product that helps companies cut energy waste and costs A small, senior-leaning team with short decision paths and close access to customers Top-of-market team, flat hierarchy — work alongside people who push you to get better Central office, easy commute — free lunch every Tuesday and Thursday Wellpass membership Regular 1:1s and retros focused on your growth Hybrid setup based in our Munich office, with regular in-person days alongside the team The Application Send us your CV and portfolio — we don't do long forms or generic cover letters. Surprise us. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Platform Engineer (m/f/d)
description: What we are building ecoplanet builds the operating system for the energy transition. Our software helps European businesses cut energy costs, run more efficiently, and take the pain out of managing energy day to day. We are around 40 people and backed by EQT Ventures, HV Capital and others. Why This Role Matters You build and run the platform the whole product sits on: the event streams, the backend services and the cloud infrastructure everything else is built on. Meter readings arrive from industrial sites across Europe, through messages or us accessing APIs. Your job is to make sure that traffic lands reliably, moves through the system in a shape other teams can build on, and keeps doing so as the number of sites grows. You join a team of 12 engineers in two squads. Small team, real ownership, and what you build reaches customers in weeks rather than quarters. What you will work on Event streaming. Kafka is the spine of the system. You own topic and schema design, partitioning, retention and delivery semantics and the everyday reality behind them: consumers falling behind, replays, backfills, late and duplicated readings. Backend services in TypeScript. The ingestion services, integrations and APIs around that stream. Every site is a little different, so a good part of the job is turning that variety into one consistent interface the product squads can rely on. Cloud infrastructure on GCP . Compute, networking, IAM, infrastructure as code, CI/CD and observability. The goal is a paved road: other engineers ship and debug their own services without going through you. Technical direction. You are senior enough to set it. Where we invest in the platform, what we standardise, what we deliberately leave rough for now and bringing the rest of the team along with it. What Sets You Up for Success Must have: At least 6–8 years building and running backend systems in production, including real time in a platform or infrastructure role that other engineers depended on Strong backend engineering in TypeScript. You have designed, shipped and operated services and APIs in it — not just touched it around the edges of a frontend Hands-on with Kafka in production. Topic design, consumer groups, ordering and delivery guarantees, and what you actually do at 3am when a consumer group is hours behind. A comparable streaming platform is fine if you know it at that depth Solid on GCP or an equivalent cloud: containers, networking and IAM basics, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, monitoring and alerting. You have owned infrastructure, not just deployed onto it Comfortable with high-volume time-series data: ingestion, data quality, backfills, and the everyday reality of late, missing and duplicated readings You have seen a few things. Enough production years behind you to know which trade-offs come back to bite, when the boring option is the right one, and how to make a call with incomplete information instead of waiting for certainty Kubernetes knowledge at the level of running it, not only deploying to it. Clear written and spoken English. German is a plus Nice to have: Energy, industrial, IoT or another domain where the data comes off real hardware Metering or device protocols, telemetry at scale, or streaming pipelines Knowledge of a second programming language, like Python, Go or Kotlin You run what you build: monitoring, alerting, and the occasional early morning debugging a pipeline What You Get Top-of-market team, flat hierarchy — work alongside people who push you to get better Competitive salary Full ownership from day one — you actively shape our company Central office, easy commute — free lunch every Tuesday and Thursday Wellpass membership Regular 1:1s and retros focused on your growth Real impact — your work supports Europe's transition to a smarter energy system Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Head of Engineering (m/f/d)
description: What we are building ecoplanet builds the operating system for the energy transition. Our software helps European businesses cut energy costs, run more efficiently, and take the pain out of managing energy day to day. We are around 40 people and backed by EQT Ventures, HV Capital and others. Why This Role Matters You lead engineering at ecoplanet: 11 engineers in two squads, including two squad leads. This is the most senior engineering role in the company. There is no CTO above you. You own the technical direction, not just the delivery of someone else's plan, and you are the engineering voice on the leadership team. It is also a hands-on job. With a team this size you stay close to the code and the architecture. If you have been away from technical work for a few years, this might not be the right role for you. What you will own: The team. 11 engineers, which includes two engineering managers. Hiring, performance, growth, and keeping good people The systems. Our Cockpit SaaS platform, the metering and IoT integration layer, the data platform (time-series ingestion, quality, pipelines), the forecasting and optimization services, and the automation that acts on customer assets The technical direction. Architecture, build-vs-buy, and the big platform calls Delivery. Quarterly roadmap execution, owned together with Product Operations. Reliability, on-call, incidents, security posture, and cloud spend What You’ll Achieve Get the best out of the team you have and grow only where it clearly adds. At 11 people, losing one strong engineer costs more than one extra hire gains. But you should be capable of growing the team substantially if business demands it Turn the roadmap into commitments the company can count on. Surface dependencies early, clear blockers, and make the trade-off calls with Product and the founders. We expect engineering to care about business and product and we expect you to be an example here Set the architecture so it holds as data volume, customer count and the team grow. Run incidents properly: fast response, honest postmortems, fixes that stop the same thing happening again Keep enough processes to be reliable and no more. A 11-person team should not feel like a 100-person one Work closely with Product, Data Science, our energy market experts and other disciplines, so we build against the real physical and regulatory constraints What Sets You Up for Success Must have 3+ years of experience leading engineering teams before in a product company, including senior engineers or squad leads You have done it in a lean team, hands-on, without a layer of managers to delegate to. Some excellent large-company leaders struggle here. There is no layer to hide behind You have personally owned delivery predictability and reliability for a production system real customers depend on, and you can tell us what it looked like before and after Strong technical judgment in at least two of: cloud and distributed backend / multi-tenant SaaS; high-volume or time-series data pipelines; IoT, device integration and real-time telemetry; ML or optimization in production. Deep enough to earn engineers' trust, make architecture calls and set the technical direction yourself You have run hiring and performance for real: you have grown people, and you have also managed people out when that was the right call You treat incident management, security and compliance as yours to own, not to delegate Clear written and spoken English. German is a strong plus — most of our customers are German Mittelstand Nice to have Energy, industrial, SaaS or a physical-world domain. Having been the most senior technical person somewhere before (CTO, VP Engineering, or the person everyone asked). Not required Being the strongest coder on the team. You do need to read the code, make architecture calls, and occasionally build something. A “Head of” title already. We look at what you have done, not what it was called. title: Medical Director (m/w/x)
description: Role Als Medical Director verantwortest du den medizinischen Themenkatalog einer der größten CME-Lernplattformen Deutschlands. Was wir zeigen, erreicht unzählige Ärzt:innen – deine inhaltlichen Entscheidungen haben unmittelbaren Einfluss darauf, welches medizinische Wissen in Deutschland ankommt. Du führst unser siebenköpfiges Medical Team, hältst den Kontakt zu Chefärzt:innen und Meinungsbildner:innen, entwickelst neue Fortbildungsformate mit und baust die Prozesse, mit denen wir vom Startup zum Scale-up werden. Die Rolle ist bewusst breit: strategisch in der Katalog- und Formatentwicklung, operativ im Tagesgeschäft, und immer mit der ärztlichen Perspektive als Maßstab. Your tasks Verantwortung für den Themenkatalog: Du steuerst, welche medizinischen Themen wir abdecken – fachübergreifend, evidenzbasiert und mit einem klaren Blick für Versorgungsrelevanz und Lücken im Markt. Referenten-Netzwerk: Du bist tagtäglich im Austausch mit Chefärzt:innen und KOLs, baust langfristige Beziehungen auf und gewinnst daraus kontinuierlich neue Fortbildungsideen. Team-Leadership: Du führst und entwickelst unser Medical Team – zwei Vollzeitkolleg:innen und fünf Studierende. Die Medical Editors arbeiten inhaltlich und stimmen Projekte mit Sponsoren und Referent:innen ab; die Medical Students übernehmen Quality Control, erstellen Kursbeschreibungen und entwickeln neue Themenideen. Formatentwicklung: Wir produzieren Videos, Panel-Diskussionen und E-Learnings – Form und Inhalt greifen ineinander. Bei neuen Formaten wie Kurzvideos oder der Gamification des Lernerlebnisses ist dein medizinischer Input und die ärztliche Perspektive der entscheidende Faktor. Projekt- und Themensteuerung: Du managst die Themenideen laufender Projekte und stimmst dich eng mit Referent:innen ab, damit Projektanforderungen inhaltlich sauber umgesetzt werden. Qualitätssicherung & Compliance: Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Fortbildungen den CME-Standards entsprechen, evidenzbasiert sind und die regulatorischen Anforderungen erfüllen. Prozessverbesserung & Automatisierung: Auf unserem Weg zum Scale-up stehen Automatisierung und schlanke Prozesse im Mittelpunkt. Du streamlinest Workflows und Dokumentationstools im Team und teamübergreifend – als Director bist du dabei die Schlüsselrolle für funktionierende Cross-Department-Zusammenarbeit. Your profile Hintergrund: Abgeschlossenes Studium der Medizin. Berufserfahrung: Idealerweise 5+ Jahre Berufserfahrung, gern klinisch, in der Industrie oder in der digitalen Gesundheitsbranche. Führungserfahrung: Erste Erfahrung als Team Lead ist ein klarer Vorteil – entscheidend ist, dass du Menschen entwickeln und Prioritäten setzen kannst. Anpack-Mindset: Wir skalieren. Du regelst Dinge selbst, statt sie nur zu delegieren, und scheust dich nicht davor, auch operativ mit reinzugehen. Begeisterung für Prozesse: Du hast Freude an Projektmanagement, Strukturaufbau und medizinischem Content bzw. medizinischer Lehre – diese Kombination ist der Kern der Rolle. Von Vorteil: Erfahrung in einem Startup sowie in der medizinischen Lehre. Kommunikationsstärke: Sicheres Auftreten gegenüber führenden Mediziner:innen und Industriepartnern, professioneller Kommunikationsstil mündlich und schriftlich. Sprachen: Deutsch auf Muttersprachenniveau und fließendes Englisch sind Voraussetzung. Why us? Echter Impact: Die Themen, die du verantwortest, erreichen über zig tausende Ärzt:innen. Durch die Verbreitung des neuesten medizinischen Wissens hast du direkten Einfluss auf die Versorgungsqualität in Deutschland. Mitgestaltung: Du prägst neue Fortbildungsformate und den medizinischen Qualitätsanspruch der Plattform von Grund auf mit. title: Forward Deployed Engineer - AI
description: <p> </p> <p class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-start="184" data-end="439">Enterprises are adopting AI faster than they can govern it — and they are looking for a partner who can do two things at once: speak credibly about AI trust, governance, and security, and actually build. The Forward Deployed Engineer (AI) is that partner.</p> <p class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-start="184" data-end="439"> </p> <p data-start="441" data-end="780">You are the technical face of AvePoint inside client organizations: equally comfortable whiteboarding AI trust and governance concepts with a CISO, translating a business problem into a scoped AI build project, and writing the first working prototype yourself. You embed with clients, ship real outcomes, and own the engagement end to end.</p> <p data-start="441" data-end="780"> </p> <p data-start="782" data-end="1078">This is not a pre-sales role with a demo script, and not a back-office delivery role. It is the engagement model pioneered by leading AI companies for their strategic enterprise customers: a senior engineer deployed forward, with the autonomy to own the problem from first workshop to production.</p> <p data-start="782" data-end="1078"> </p> <h1 data-section-id="1b5pyf7" data-start="1080" data-end="1096">What you'll do</h1> <h3 data-section-id="1rd6iho" data-start="1098" data-end="1136">Advise on AI trust and governance.</h3> <p data-start="1137" data-end="1641">Lead workshops that help clients understand and take control of their AI landscape — agents, copilots, models, and the data behind them, including the shadow AI they didn't know about. Explain AI governance, security posture, and resilience concepts credibly to both technical teams and executives. Guide clients through obligations such as the EU AI Act, NIS2, and ISO 42001, and help them stand up practical operating models: AI inventories, approval workflows, risk classification, and audit evidence.</p> <h3 data-section-id="1vy74ta" data-start="1643" data-end="1681">Scope and shape AI build projects.</h3> <p data-start="1682" data-end="2121">Sit with business stakeholders to understand the underlying need behind "we want AI for X." Identify the highest-value use cases, define success criteria, and translate ambiguous requirements into concrete, estimable technical scopes — architecture outlines, data and integration requirements, delivery phases, effort and risk assessments. Write statements of work that engineering teams can actually deliver and clients can actually sign.</p> <h3 data-section-id="1elmp9s" data-start="2123" data-end="2145">Build and deliver.</h3> <p data-start="2146" data-end="2546">Develop prototypes and production components for client AI solutions: agent workflows, RAG pipelines, LLM integrations (Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex, Anthropic), MCP-based tool integrations, and the governance and security controls around them. Deliver custom adapters and local tooling for regulated, cloud-restricted, or air-gapped environments where standard SaaS approaches cannot go.</p> <h3 data-section-id="8xgjwk" data-start="2548" data-end="2590">Own the relationship through delivery.</h3> <p data-start="2591" data-end="2805">Act as the trusted technical advisor from first workshop through go-live: run enablement sessions, support adoption, troubleshoot in production, and expand the engagement where you see genuine value for the client.</p> <h1 data-section-id="kq6nv6" data-start="2807" data-end="2831">What we're looking for</h1> <h2 data-section-id="1wfooam" data-start="2833" data-end="2846">Must-haves</h2> <ul data-start="2848" data-end="4211"> <li data-section-id="1savupk" data-start="2848" data-end="3035">5+ years in software engineering, solutions architecture, or technical consulting, with at least 2 years hands-on with modern AI/LLM systems in real projects (not only experimentation).</li> <li data-section-id="qxlgzp" data-start="3036" data-end="3234">Practical experience building with LLM APIs and frameworks (e.g., Azure OpenAI, Bedrock, Vertex, LangChain, Semantic Kernel) and patterns such as RAG, agentic workflows, and tool/function calling.</li> <li data-section-id="5cohv6" data-start="3235" data-end="3474"><strong data-start="3237" data-end="3268">Machine Learning Expertise:</strong> Hands-on machine learning experience spanning model development, evaluation, deployment, and operationalization, with a focus on enterprise AI solutions, predictive analytics, and scalable MLOps practices.</li> <li data-section-id="4qgzw0" data-start="3475" data-end="3667">Strong programming skills in Python and/or C#/TypeScript, plus working fluency with at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including identity, networking, and data services.</li> <li data-section-id="u9bkd2" data-start="3668" data-end="3894">Demonstrated ability to scope technical projects from ambiguous business requirements: you can run a requirements workshop, challenge assumptions constructively, and produce a credible plan with phases, estimates, and risks.</li> <li data-section-id="i43vcd" data-start="3895" data-end="4098">Excellent communication in front of senior stakeholders — you can explain why AI governance matters to a board member and debate vector database trade-offs with a platform engineer in the same meeting.</li> <li data-section-id="16b5uac" data-start="4099" data-end="4211">Willingness to travel to client sites and to operate with high autonomy in ambiguous, fast-moving engagements.</li> </ul> <h2 data-section-id="gbyf8a" data-start="4213" data-end="4229">Strong pluses</h2> <ul data-start="4231" data-end="5098"> <li data-section-id="otf7d0" data-start="4231" data-end="4368">Working knowledge of AI governance and compliance frameworks: EU AI Act, NIS2, ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF, or Gartner's AI TRiSM model.</li> <li data-section-id="1457rsl" data-start="4369" data-end="4515">Experience with AI security topics: prompt injection, data leakage, agent permissioning, model and data security posture (AI-SPM/DSPM concepts).</li> <li data-section-id="1l5daxl" data-start="4516" data-end="4648">Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent runtimes, or vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus, Weaviate, Chroma).</li> <li data-section-id="3crjn8" data-start="4649" data-end="4791">Background in enterprise data governance, security, backup/resilience, or the Microsoft 365 / multi-cloud ecosystem where AvePoint operates.</li> <li data-section-id="1h63k2g" data-start="4792" data-end="4936">Experience delivering into regulated industries (public sector, defense, financial services, healthcare) or air-gapped/sovereign environments.</li> <li data-section-id="1d0p8e3" data-start="4937" data-end="5036">Prior experience in a forward-deployed, embedded consulting, or customer-facing engineering role.</li> <li data-section-id="49tosn" data-start="5037" data-end="5098">Additional languages relevant to your region's client base.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h1 data-section-id="1bghwns" data-start="5100" data-end="5127">How we'll measure success</h1> <p data-start="5129" data-end="5421">Within your first 6–12 months, you will have led AI discovery and governance workshops for multiple enterprise clients, scoped and won at least one significant AI build or governance engagement, and delivered working software into a client environment. Above all: clients ask for you by name.</p> <p data-start="5129" data-end="5421"> </p> <h1 data-section-id="yoij66" data-start="5423" data-end="5447">Why this role, why now</h1> <p data-start="5449" data-end="5893">AI adoption has outrun enterprise control, and regulators have noticed. Every large organization now needs to see, govern, secure, and sustain its AI estate — and most need a partner who can both advise and build. As an FDE at AvePoint you will help define this engagement model from the ground floor, work at the frontier of agentic AI and AI trust, and do it with two decades of enterprise data governance and resilience expertise behind you.</p> <p data-start="5449" data-end="5893"> </p> <p data-start="5449" data-end="5893"><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">#LI-SB1</span></p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span data-teams="true"><span class="ui-provider a b c d e f g h i j k l m n o p q r s t u v w x y z ab ac ae af ag ah ai aj ak">Any personal data you share with us during the application process will be processed strictly in compliance with applicable data protection laws and our <a id="menur12n" class="fui-Link ___1q1shib f2hkw1w f3rmtva f1ewtqcl fyind8e f1k6fduh f1w7gpdv fk6fouc fjoy568 figsok6 f1s184ao f1mk8lai fnbmjn9 f1o700av f13mvf36 f1cmlufx f9n3di6 f1ids18y f1tx3yz7 f1deo86v f1eh06m1 f1iescvh fhgqx19 f1olyrje f1p93eir f1nev41a f1h8hb77 f1lqvz6u f10aw75t fsle3fq f17ae5zn" href="https://www.avepoint.com/company/privacy-notice" target="_blank">Privacy Notice</a>.</span></span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Data Scientist, Marketing DSA
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>Brief info about Vinted </strong></h2> <p data-renderer-start-pos="1"><span data-sheets-root="1">Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. <br>The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:<br><br><strong><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/marketplace" target="_blank">Vinted Marketplace</a></strong> is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedgo" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Go</strong></a> enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedpay" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Pay</strong></a> is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.<br><br>Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. </span></p></div><h2><strong>Information about the position </strong></h2> <p>Vinted’s <strong>Marketing domain</strong> is growing - we’re on a mission to make Vinted known and loved as the go-to destination for everything second-hand. Marketing is one of the primary drivers behind our biggest strategic goals, from <strong>winning the USA market</strong> to expanding beyond fashion into a <strong>multi-vertical platform</strong>.</p> <p>We’re looking a <strong>Senior Data Scientist</strong> to join our <strong>Marketing Data Science and Analytics</strong> team to hands-on build, refine, and scale our core predictive and explanatory models. In this role, you will be the technical engine behind our Bayesian Media Mix Models (MMM), user value machine learning models, and advanced statistical frameworks. title: AI Associate - m/f/d
description: Help Us Change the Way the World Works Build something that matters. Langdock exists to change the way the world works, bridging the gap between what technology can do and what people actually do with it. We bring all leading AI models into one secure, model-agnostic platform and make them usable across entire organizations. Over 10,000 companies use our platform every day, from fast-growing startups to some of Europe's largest enterprises. Their employees open Langdock to draft strategies, analyze documents, or automate workflows - helping them to work smarter, think more creatively, and reach their full potential. About the Role This is a full-time, 12-month program at our Berlin HQ for people who want to understand AI rather than just use it. It begins where our product meets the real world: customer support. Many support tickets are a small puzzle about how large language models and cloud software behave in production. Why did the same prompt give two different answers? Why did a long document get cut off? Why is one model fast today and slow tomorrow? Why did an agent call the wrong tool? Why did an API integration time out? You will be the person who works out what is actually going on and explains it clearly. For most of your first year, the support queue is your home base and your classroom. Few jobs expose you to as many real AI systems, real enterprise environments, and real failure modes, every single day. The purpose of the year: by month twelve, you should understand our platform and operations deeply, from the chat interface down to the models and infrastructure behind it. A Langdock business team should want to hire you permanently, and you should have found the work that energizes you most. What You Will Learn to Understand Customers ask the questions that the rest of the world is still figuring out. To answer them, you will build real intuition for: How LLMs actually behave : tokens and context windows, sampling and non-determinism, hallucinations, prompt sensitivity, system prompts, and why models from different providers react differently to the same input. Agents, tools, and retrieval : how agents plan and call tools, how knowledge bases and document search feed context to a model, and where these chains tend to break. Cloud software in production : APIs, authentication and SSO, rate limits, latency, integrations, multi-tenant enterprise setups, data residency, and access control. Inference and compute : what happens when a request hits a model, why throughput, latency, and cost trade off against each other, and how running our own inference changes what we can offer customers. Daily operational tasks : resolving billing issues, reporting bugs and being the point of for our customers. You do not need to know all of this on day one. You need to be the kind of person who cannot stop asking why until you do. How the Year Works Onboarding: Learn the platform by supporting it. You go through an intensive onboarding into our products, the underlying models, and the support queue. You shadow your first tickets, get to know our systems, and start resolving real customer issues. Expect plenty of experimenting, plenty of questions, and a steep learning curve. Post-Onboarding: Own the queue and take on sidequests. Alongside the queue, you start picking up work from other teams: tasks below the threshold for a specialist to own but too valuable for your learning to ignore. This includes taking a sales call for a new lead, running a short customer workshop, building customer use cases, writing internal documentation, building internal agents, and further building out our own AI support tooling. As our inference and cloud offering grows, you will increasingly help customers understand and adopt it. What You Will Do Front-line customer support. Spend most of your day in the queue, handling customer tickets end-to-end across model behavior, API integrations, enterprise compliance, billing, and access control. Investigate what is happening under the hood. Reproduce issues, compare model behavior, read logs and API responses, and separate "the model did something unexpected" from "the system did something wrong." Then give users clear, empathetic, and accurate answers. Explain AI to the people who use it. Help customers understand non-determinism, model limits, context handling, latency, and model choice in plain language, so they can use AI with confidence. Take on cross-team sidequests. Pick up the real work that falls between teams, like a small inbound sales call, a customer workshop, a piece of documentation, or an internal automation. These tasks are small in scope, but you fully own them. Escalate to engineering and product. Flag recurring user friction, document edge cases with clear reproduction steps, and report bugs directly to the engineers building our platform and infrastructure. Improve support with AI. Propose practical improvements to our support workflow and build and test the internal AI tooling that helps resolve routine questions faster. What Graduation Looks Like You start on a 12-month fixed-term contract. The program is designed so that strong performance turns into a permanent contract in a business department that suits your strengths: AI Adoption Management, Sales, Partnerships, Marketing, Recruiting, RevOps, Operations, Solutions Engineering, or elsewhere in the Business team. We are expanding fast in two directions: across the work people do , with chat, agents, meetings, code, and apps; and down the stack , into our own cloud, compute, and inference. Wherever you land, you will bring something rare: a deep, hands-on understanding of how AI and AI infrastructure actually behave for real customers. We make the decision together based on your performance in the queue, how you handled sidequests, and whether the team you want to join has a role for you. So far, AI Associates have graduated into Account/AI Adoption Management, Sales and Solutions Engineering. We are looking to broaden the program as a gateway into all business functions. You Might Be a Fit If… You are fascinated by how AI works. You have gone down rabbit holes on why models behave the way they do, and you want a job where that curiosity is the core of the work. You want to understand the stack, not just the surface. Cloud software, APIs, and inference interest you, and you are excited to learn how models are served, scaled, and made fast and reliable. You are genuinely excited about front-line AI support. You take pride in helping customers, write with patience and clarity, and enjoy working through a busy ticket queue. You think in systems and love analysis. You enjoy breaking down tricky technical or operational problems and figuring out what is really happening under the hood. You show high agency and full ownership. You see a ticket through from first message to resolution and dig into root causes so the same issues do not keep coming back. You experiment constantly. You try new models, automations, and tools, and you instinctively look for ways technology can make work easier. You communicate clearly and professionally in English. German is a plus and useful in the queue. You are kind and care about the people around you. What We Need Availability to start full-time and work 100% on-site at our Berlin office for the full 12 months. A work permit for Germany. Technical or analytical grounding. Du skalierst unser Creator-Netzwerk: Du pflegst unsere Creator-Datenbank, entwickelst sie weiter und schaffst die Grundlage für nachhaltiges Wachstum. Du arbeitest crossfunktional: Gemeinsam mit Performance Marketing und Creative entwickelst du Kampagnen, die kreativ überzeugen und messbare Ergebnisse liefern. Du kannst verhandeln: Du hast bereits Deals mit Creators oder Managements verhandelt und weißt, wie man starke Partnerschaften aufsetzt. You ask the algo team why. You propose the test. You don't wait for someone to assign it. Move Fast: Start Simple, Iterate Quickly. You also don't drift past day 14 without a verdict. Focus on Impact: Deliver What's Most Important. You'd rather move €500K of monthly spend on the top account than €50K across five small ones. title: Strategy & Operations Associate
description: About the Role Taktile empowers financial institutions to transform into truly AI-native organizations. We’re growing rapidly with enterprise customers across banks and insurance companies, and we’re looking for a Strategy & Operations Associate Ops is the thread that runs through everything at Taktile. As we enter our next phase of growth, we are professionalizing how the company operates, so we can grow fast without losing focus or quality. That's where you come in. As our Strategy & Operations Associate , you will sit at the center of the company's growth story. This is a hands-on, high-trust role for someone who wants to learn company-building from the inside, move fast, and see their impact on the business within days. You will become part of the company's highest-leverage projects, surrounded by people who expect excellence and care about building something that lasts. What you will do You come in wherever needed to help us move fast - one week this could mean helping with all hands messaging, FDE hiring and introducing new AI-enabled processes, the other week this could mean working on pricing strategy, creating competition battle cards or establishing new partnerships Know the org inside out: understand how we work, prioritize, and measure success - and proactively improve our ops by partnering with teams across the whole company - e.g., Strategy & Operations, GTM, Product, and G&A Help shape and evolve our long-term operating model, acting as a force multiplier across the leadership team - owning key operating cadences & cross-functional alignments Your Profile You are hungry to build and get energy from moving fast You move fluidly between big-picture strategy and the operational detail that makes it real You like to get your hands dirty — you solve problems hands-on, not just in a slide deck You're a structured thinker — you take messy, complex problems and turn them into a clear plan others rally behind You're AI-native — you reach for AI tools instinctively to move faster and think sharper You're a clear, concise communicator with high ownership — people trust you to run with things and deliver 1-2 of experience in strategy, consulting, or a fast-scaling startup What We Offer Work with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you'll find yourself at home here. Make an impact and meaningfully shape an early-stage company. Experience a truly flat hierarchy and communicate directly with founding team members. Having an opinion and voicing your ideas is not only welcome but encouraged, especially when they challenge the status quo. Learn from experienced mentors and achieve tremendous personal and professional growth. Get to know and leverage our network of leading tech investors and advisors around the globe. Receive a top-of-market equity and cash compensation package. Get access to a self-development budget you can use to e.g. attend conferences, buy books or take classes. Use the equipment of your choice including meaningful home office set-up. Our Stance We're eager to meet talented and driven candidates regardless of whether they tick all the boxes. We're looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply. We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions, and celebrate love in its many forms. We won't inquire about how you identify or if you've experienced discrimination, but if you want to tell your story, we are all ears. About Taktile Taktile enables banks and insurers to transform into AI-native organizations that are increasingly powered by autonomous agents. With our modular Agentic Decision Platform, customers combine AI agents, rules, relevant context, and human oversight to safely automate and optimize their decisions — approving more customers, reimbursing claims instantly, and financing every business worth funding. Founded in 2020, Taktile powers millions of decisions daily for institutions including Pleo, Monzo, and Faire. With offices in New York, London, Berlin, São Paulo, and Iași, we've raised $184M from Goldman Sachs Growth Equity, Index Ventures, Tiger Global, Balderton Capital, and Y Combinator. Learn more at taktile.com About Your Employment. Taktile operates through regional entities worldwide. title: Alpha Plant Systems Lead
description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO Shape the architecture of the world’s first commercial fusion power plant – Own system-level decisions that determine how a first-of-a-kind energy technology is designed, integrated, and ultimately deployed at scale. Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges – Work across tightly coupled disciplines (plasma physics, magnets, cryogenics, manufacturing, controls, and more) to resolve critical trade-offs and turn cutting-edge science into a functioning product. Design real hardware with a pragmatic, fast-moving team from all over the world – Combine advanced simulation and systems thinking with a strong execution mindset, focusing on practical engineering solutions that accelerate the path to commercial fusion energy. YOUR IMPACT Shape the architecture of the world’s first net energy gain stellarator by taking full responsibility for the design, integration, and delivery of Alpha’s ancillary systems. You will own the system-level decisions that determine how breakthrough technology is integrated and delivered. Taking accountability for the tritium fuel cycle, high voltage electrical power, heating sources, cryogenic and non-cryogenic cooling systems, and waste water treatment, you will also take total ownership of the complexity between them and the stellarator: the piping, distribution networks, and critical infrastructure that connect them. You will lead the team of teams translating the needs of Alpha into the physical delivery of major ancillaries, bridging in-house talent and external contractors. Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in industry: this role demands deep, hands-on technical judgement and the ability to make impactful design decisions across a wide range of tightly coupled disciplines to turn cutting-edge science into a functioning facility. WHAT YOU WILL DO Drive integrated system design and delivery: Own the integrated design of the ancillary systems and all interconnecting infrastructure to seamlessly embed them into the wider Alpha facility. Modernize the engineering approach: Bring a forward-thinking vision to the industrial facility development process by including, for example, advanced process engineering techniques, modern Building Information Modeling (BIM), and 4D assembly planning. Own the interfaces and the budget: Manage complex trade-offs and resolve critical design constraints by collaborating closely with stellarator engineering and facility teams. You will own the budget for these systems and serve as the primary technical interface with external stakeholders and regulatory bodies. Build systems with a fast-moving team: Combine systems thinking with a pragmatic execution mindset. You will lead across the ancillary systems, providing the judgement needed to unblock cross-system challenges and facility trade decisions. Execute safe and successful operations: Define the safety logic and lead the integrated installation, commissioning, and maintenance strategies for Alpha’s ancillary systems. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR End-to-End Infrastructure Delivery: A proven track record owning major projects, from design through to construction, commissioning, and handover. Relevant Industrial Experience: First-hand experience witnessing and delivering complex plant engineering and facilities. Broad backgrounds that are relevant for this role include manufacturing, data centers, refineries, chemical plants, or industrial gas production. Deep Technical and Design Judgement: Strong technical skillsets beyond delivery management with the ability to lead design decisions regarding complex facility integration. Systems & Execution Mindset: The ability to balance inputs from multidisciplinary technical teams and a bias to action in resolving critical trade-offs. Agility and Leadership: Team players who thrive in fast moving, high growth environments. Demonstrated ability to manage large internal and external work packages. INTERVIEW PROCESS Recruiter Interview (30-45 min) Technical Screening (30 min) Technical Panel (3x60 min) CEO call (30 min) Successful applicants will be assigned to one of the Engineering teams within Proxima, depending on their specific skills, location, and the needs of the organisation. This role sits at L4 of our framework, please inquire during the recruitment process for further information At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Head of Accounting & Tax (f/m/x)
description: Our goal is to have a solar system on every roof, a storage unit in every house, and an electric car in every garage. Enpal makes this possible with an integrated total solution for decentralized energy—from solar systems and battery storage to wall boxes, smart meters, and heat pumps. At the heart of it all is our AI-powered platform Enpal.One +, which intelligently connects thousands of systems and efficiently optimizes electricity procurement and feed-in on the energy market. EFS is a fintech company specialising in the financing of decentralised energy solutions such as photovoltaic systems and heat pumps. As a factoring and leasing company and an independent subsidiary of the Enpal Group, we enable installation companies and project developers to offer simple instalment and financing solutions to their customers. Our mission is to accelerate the energy transition through accessible and customer-focused financing products. What you’ll do As Head of Accounting & Tax (f/m/x), you will lead the accounting and tax function at EFS. You will be responsible for reliable HGB and IFRS reporting, timely financial close processes, budgeting, tax compliance and the accounting of factoring / leasing of receivables as well as SPV and financing structures. This is a hands-on role with significant exposure to the business. You own the monthly and annual closing processes for EFS and ensure reliable, high-quality financial reporting. You translate business plans into budgets and forecasts in close collaboration with Enpal Group Finance and relevant business stakeholders. You ensure accurate reporting under HGB and IFRS, including the preparation of IFRS adjustments. You coordinate consolidation and financial statement preparation across relevant entities. You oversee the accounting treatment of factoring and leasing transactions, receivables, financing arrangements, asset transfers and related intercompany transactions. You manage accounting for SPVs, securitisation and other financing structures. You coordinate corporate tax and VAT compliance together with external tax advisors and Enpal Group functions. You build and continuously improve accounting policies, processes and internal controls. You coordinate internal and external audits and ensure that findings are addressed in a timely and structured manner. You further develop the accounting and tax function, including team structures, responsibilities and processes. You drive the automation, scalability and efficiency of reporting and closing processes. You act as a key accounting and tax partner for EFS management and stakeholders across the Enpal Group. What you’ll bring You hold a degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration or a comparable field. You bring several years of relevant experience in audit, financial reporting, group accounting or a comparable finance function. You have strong knowledge of IFRS and HGB and experience with statutory reporting, consolidation and financial close processes. You are familiar with corporate tax and VAT compliance. You bring relevant experience in factoring, leasing, financial services, lending, receivables management or another asset-finance environment. A background in a Big Four or comparable audit environment is a plus, ideally combined with experience in a start-up, scale-up or other dynamic organisation. Experience with SPVs, securitisation or other financing structures is an advantage. Experience with core banking systems or comparable financial systems is a plus. You work in a structured, pragmatic and solution-oriented way and enjoy improving processes and building scalable structures. You are comfortable working with cross-functional stakeholders and translating complex financial topics into clear, actionable decisions. title: Client Partner
description: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. Location This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location with regular travel to client sites across the DACH region. Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by blp. Your Mission You own the client outcome on our largest strategic accounts, from the moment the contract is signed to the moment the solution is running at scale, and you carry the revenue that comes with it. Our customers do not buy software, they buy a change in how their organization runs. Automating core processes end-to-end frees capacity that was locked in manual execution. Consolidating fragmented point solutions onto one platform lowers what the process landscape costs to own. And running those processes with full transparency gives finance something it rarely has, a reliable real-time view of what is actually happening, which is what makes forecasting and financial steering possible. Delivering that on a strategic account takes a full blp team: a Senior Project Manager and Project Managers, Integrations Engineers and a Technical Project Manager, a Consultant with AI Automation Specialists, and our Customer Success Engineers. Your job is to make that team deliver for your customers, to hold the relationship at executive level while it happens, and to grow the account once the value is proven. You make sure a strategic customer gets what it was promised: a custom Academy for its teams, priority support, and whatever automation effort it takes to reach the productivity we committed to. You are not managing a queue and you are not running the project plan. You carry a focused portfolio of our largest customers, and you are the one person accountable for whether they consider blp a success. title: Senior Security Engineer
description: ÜBER UNSERE COMPANY freiheit.com wurde 1999 in Hamburg gegründet und entwickelt seitdem custom large-scale Softwareprodukte. Unsere Mission ist: “Ship great software”. In mehr als zwei Jahrzehnten haben wir immer das ausgeliefert, was wir versprochen haben – “always on time, on budget, on target and on quality”. 85% unserer Members sind Software Engineers mit Abschlüssen in Informatik, Physik oder Mathematik, viele auch mit fundierten Kenntnissen in Maschinellem Lernen und Künstlicher Intelligenz. Seit über einem Vierteljahrhundert arbeiten wir für das „Who’s Who“ der deutschen und europäischen Industrie- und Handelsunternehmen. Retail, Automotive, E-Commerce, Healthcare und mehr. Unsere large-scale Softwareprodukte werden täglich von Millionen von Benutzern verwendet und sind entscheidend für den wirtschaftlichen Erfolg unserer Kunden. Jedes Produkt ist somit geschäftskritisch und ist von strategischer Relevanz. Gemeinsam machen wir “mission impossible possible”. Unser Team besteht aus 300+ Members aus der ganzen Welt. In unseren Büros in Hamburg und Lissabon bauen wir gemeinsam Produkte, die noch nie jemand zuvor entwickelt hat. Unsere Teams arbeiten datengetrieben, um ihre eigene Produktivität ständig zu optimieren. Jedes Teammitglied übernimmt die “end-to-end” Verantwortung für seine Arbeit. Um erfolgreich zu sein, muss man produktiv sein. Um produktiv zu sein, muss man effizient und effektiv sein. Technology never rests. Neither do we. ÜBER DEINEN JOB Wir sind eine Engineering Organisation – auf jeder Ebene sind bei uns Engineers verantwortlich – auch in der Sicherheit. Deshalb kann nur ein echter Engineer unsere Security verantworten. Als Senior Security Engineer bist Du Primus inter Pares: Du beherrschst das Handwerk exzellent und steuerst gemeinsam mit Deinem Team die Compliance bei freiheit.com über Code und Automation. Deine Rolle & Perspektive: Führung mit Ziel: Du steigst an der Seite der aktuellen Leitung ein, lernst unsere Systeme tiefgreifend kennen und übernimmst mittelfristig die vollständige Führung des Security-Teams (direkt unter dem CEO). Strategischer Weitblick: Du planst technologische und regulatorische Anforderungen für die nächsten 6 bis 24 Monate proaktiv voraus. Engineering & Automation: Du entwickelst Infrastruktur selbst und automatisierst manuelle Aufwände konsequent durch Code. Compliance & Governance: Du trägst die Hauptverantwortung für unser ISMS (TISAX), steuerst das Incident Handling und prüfst Verträge rund um IT-Sicherheit und Datenschutz (unterstützt von Fachanwälten & HiSolutions). Enablement: Du schulst unsere Entwickler:innen und hilfst ihnen, von Beginn an sichere Projektarchitekturen zu bauen. ÜBER DICH Du bist erfahrener Software Engineer und hast bereits erste oder fundierte Schritte in den Bereichen Führung, Strategie, Security und Compliance gemacht? Bei uns übernimmst Du die Verantwortung, diese Themen auf das nächste Level zu heben. Dazu bringst du folgendes mit: Ausbildung & Erfahrung: Bachelor-Abschluss in Informatik, Mathematik, Physik oder Elektrotechnik (Master/Promotion von Vorteil). Leadership & Strategie: Nachweisbare Erfahrung im Aufbau und der Führung von Engineering-Teams sowie in strategischer Planung und Incident Handling. Security & Compliance: Erfahrung in der Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung eines ISMS (ideal VDA/ISA bzw. TISAX). Engineering-Stack: Fundierte Kenntnisse in UNIX-Systemadministration, Networking, Docker, Kubernetes sowie Programmiererfahrung (idealerweise Go). Track Record: Ein spürbar hoher Einfluss auf den technischen Erfolg Deiner bisherigen Projekte sowie eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe. Du sprichst fließend Deutsch (mind. C1) und verhandlungssicheres Englisch. Bonus-Skills & Interessen Erfahrung in der Prüfung von Datenschutz- und Security-Verträgen. Hands-on-Erfahrung mit Cloud-Plattformen (GCP, AWS, Azure), verteilten Systemen (Terraform) und CI/CD-Pipelines. Vertrautheit mit Observability (Logging, Monitoring, Alerting, Tracing). ÜBER UNSERE COMMUNITY Auf die Frage, warum jemand hier arbeitet, lautet die Antwort oft: „wegen der Menschen“ und „weil ich in meinem Leben noch nie so viel gelernt habe“. Wir glauben, dass produktive Menschen glückliche Menschen sind. In unseren Engineering Hubs in Hamburg und Lissabon triffst du auf Menschen aus der ganzen Welt. title: Customer Engineer, Korea
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Seoul, South Korea, Singapore</strong></p> <p><strong>What you will do as a Customer Engineer</strong></p> <p>The Customer Engineer (CE) is the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted technical advisor and primary architect of the customer journey. You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Validation: </strong>Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery, capture business requirements, and map complex customer infrastructure - DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, Workers - to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. . Define, scope, success criteria, and technical evaluations plans for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Technical Validations. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively address complex technical objections, security compliance questions, and edge-case architectural requirements during the sales cycle. Take accountability for a suitable solution deployment strategy (Customer, Partner or Cloudflare Professional services) being an integral part of all proposals.</li> <li><strong>Customer Adoption & Value Realization: </strong>Provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, but not execute the implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. Design structured migration and onboarding blueprints tailored to the customer’s environment (e.g. DNS migrations, Zero Trust rollouts, WAF tuning guidance), and act as the lead consultant for customer engineering teams, walking them step-by-step through configuration best practices.  Partner with Account Executives to own discovery, demos, onboarding, technical health, risk, and expansion strategy. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Accountability & Expansion: </strong>Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisory: </strong>Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes. </li> <li><strong>AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: </strong>Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.</li> <li><strong>Education & Enablement:</strong> Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. Define, document, and educate both internal teams and customers on deliverables such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), architectural best practices, and technical guides to continuously raise the technical baseline across the organization.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience: Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Professional Services,  Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer (years of experience required will vary based on Associate, Senior, Staff, or Principal leveling).</li> <li>Architectural Mindset: Ability to white-board, design, and articulate complex enterprise network and security architectures clearly.</li> <li>Consultative & Advisory Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate deeply technical concepts into business outcomes for both hands-on engineers and C-level executives.</li> <li>Commercial Mindset: Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li>Communication: Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.</li> <li>Technical Breadth: We do not expect every candidate to be an expert in every domain. Qualified candidates will demonstrate depth in at least four of the technical areas below:</li> <ul> <li>Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS.</li> <li>Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts.</li> <li>Performance: Expertise in the performance of Internet properties, including speed, latency, caching, video streaming, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.3.</li> <li>AI Proficiency: Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted scripting and log analysis, LLM utilization, and workflow automation to augment everyday CE workflows.</li> <li>Coding/Scripting: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Bash, Lua, Go, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.</li> <li>Developer Platform Fluency: Experience designing, building, deploying or scaling applications using RESTful/GraphQL APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and developer tooling in cloud-native environments. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD pipelines, and observability for developer-led deployments.</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The "Good-to-Haves")</strong></p> <ul> <li>Technical Enablement: Track record of creating and delivering technical enablement - workshops, code samples, documentation, or developer onboarding - that accelerates customer adoption of complex platforms. </li> <li>Applied AI Knowledge: Experience with LLM orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and model-access controls.</li> <li>Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of regulatory requirements such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, and SOC 2.</li> <li>Hyperscaler / Digital Native Background: Talent coming out of hyperscalers, digital natives, distributed systems environments, or startups is strongly valued for its deeper cloud fluency and advanced architecture depth.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Education</strong></p> <p>Undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. </p> <p><strong>Travel</strong></p> <p>This role may require travel up to 20–50% to attend customer meetings, conferences, industry events, and in-person team collaboration.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;

description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. You will take full ownership of your workstream, from algorithmic research through embedded implementation and flight validation, working with high autonomy and minimal oversight. You will work closely with the EW and RF analytics teams to translate product-level requirements into deployed, mission-ready capabilities. Responsibilities Design and implement near-real-time algorithms for radar image formation, including inverse SAR (ISAR) processing of moving targets. Develop and refine detection and tracking algorithms (e.g., EKF/UKF-based approaches) for moving target indication on airborne radar data. Build jamming estimation capabilities, combining out-of-band spectral sniffing with in-band spatial covariance analysis, and the adaptive logic that drives radar behavior in response. Contribute radar-derived observables and algorithms that support navigation when GNSS is unavailable. Prototype and port algorithms onto the selected embedded computing platform, balancing algorithmic performance against real-time and resource constraints. Validate algorithms end-to-end through hardware-in-the-loop bench testing, anechoic chamber campaigns, and real flight conditions, iterating quickly on results. Work closely with the EW and RF analytics modules to align signal processing development with system-level requirements. Candidate Requirements 2 to 5 years of confirmed, hands-on experience in radar signal processing, gained in the defense or automotive radar industry preferably. Solid experience in Signal Processing on radar systems, either FMCW or pulsed, is required; exposure to moving target tracking, ECCM, radar-based navigation, or live/real-time processing is a strong plus. Strong theoretical foundations and genuine hands-on comfort with the underlying mathematics, not reliance on off-the-shelf tools or LLM-generated solutions. A quick thinker, comfortable taking full ownership of a technical scope end-to-end with minimal oversight. Comfortable working in a fast, iterative cycle: writing code, running hardware-in-the-loop tests, and pushing validated changes independently. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Gestionnaire des dossiers administratifs des élèves
company: ECOLE NATIONALE SUPERIEURE DE TECHNIQUES AVANCEES
description: Contexte : ENSTA, établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées, développe des activités de formation, de recherche et d’innovation dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et de la santé. L’école, présente sur deux campus, à Paris-Saclay et à Brest, est membre de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Classée dans le Top 10 des meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France, elle a pour mission : la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, de cadres et docteurs pour les secteurs public et privé, la recherche et l’innovation de haut niveau en relation étroite avec l’industrie des grands secteurs de souveraineté au sein de 6 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR). Au sein de la Direction de la formation, le pôle « admissions, scolarité, stages », assure le cadre administratif de gestion des élèves dans leurs parcours de formation. Il agit en fonction support des directeurs de programme. Le/la titulaire du poste est affecté(e) au sein de la Direction de la Formation, sur le site de Brest, et est rattaché(e) hiérarchiquement à la Directrice du pôle « admissions, scolarité, stages ». Dans ce cadre, l’ENSTA recrute, pour son campus de Brest, un/une gestionnaire administratif qui assurera le suivi des dossiers élèves, en particulier des élèves militaires sous statut d’IETA (Ingénieur des études et techniques de l’armement) Missions / Activités principales : Le titulaire du poste est chargé(e) du suivi administratif des élèves civils : Elaboration et la diffusion des certificats de scolarité et autres documents de scolarité (certificat d'inscription ...) Suivi d’attestation CVEC Suivi des bourses étudiantes, en lien avec le CROUS, en qualité de correspondant(e) bourses. Gestion des cartes étudiantes, Gestion des demandes de financements par la formation continue, Gestion des déplacements et répartition des étudiants pour les actions de promotion de l’offre de formation, Participation aux activités du pôle Sous l'autorité fonctionnelle du Directeur des études IETA et de l'Adjointe Officiers des corps de l'armement, le/la titulaire du poste assure la gestion administrative des élèves sous statut IETA (Ingénieur des études et techniques de l’armement) : Assurer la gestion administrative et le suivi individuel des élèves militaires : dossiers, solde, cartes militaires, suivi médical, permissions, affectations, arrêts de travail, accidents, décorations, etc ; Assurer la liaison avec le service médical de la base navale de Brest ; Assurer la gestion et le suivi des habilitations des étudiants civils et des personnels du campus de Brest ; Veiller au respect des procédures, à la confidentialité et à la tenue à jour des dossiers. Activités annexes : Elaborer des tableaux de bords pour les enquêtes, statistiques et bilans Actualisation des dossiers élèves dans le SI de scolarité. Participer à la démarche Qualité de l’établissement ; Contribuer à la démarche RSE dans le cadre de ses missions et de ses activités au sein de l’Ecole. Niveau de diplôme et formations : Bac à Bac+2 en gestion administrative, gestion des ressources humaines ou dans un domaine équivalent, avec une expérience professionnelle similaire. Une expérience dans des environnements liés à l'enseignement supérieur et/au ministère des armées serait un plus. Emploi : Poste ouvert aux candidats : Fonctionnaire de catégorie C - RIFSEEP 1 Agent contractuel de catégorie C (emploi pérenne ; CDD de 1 à 3 ans renouvelable) CDI possible après 2 ans de CDD Ce poste nécessite une habilitation « SECRET » Durée d’affectation souhaitée : 3 à 5 ans Date de prise de fonctions prévue : 1er novembre 2026 Rémunération : Fonctionnaires : selon les conditions statutaires (grille indiciaire, IFSE, CIA) Contractuels : en fonction de l'expérience professionnelle sur des postes de niveau équivalent Lieu de travail : ENSTA Campus de Brest, « Le site est accessible en voiture (parking pour le personnel) ou en transports en commun. L’Ecole étant engagée dans une démarche RSE (DD-RS et employeur pro-vélo), elle encourage aux mobilités douces par la mise en place de dispositif d’aide financière (FMD) et des infrastructures adaptées aux cyclistes ». Poste à temps complet (25 jours de congés annuels, 23 RTT annuels) Avantages : Transports (participation forfaitaire de l’employeur à hauteur de 75 %) Forfait mobilité durable (jusqu’à 300€/an) Possibilité de télétravail (après période d’essai et après accord du manager et dépôt d’une demande) Subvention employeur au restaurant administratif et/ou à la cafétéria de l’établissement Comité d’action sociale, avec notamment des événements et animations proposés au personnel, salle de sport sur adhésion, Mutuelle (participation à hauteur de 50% de l’établissement) Aménagement du poste de travail et recrutement inclusif : Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux candidats en situation de handicap. ENSTA s’engage à un recrutement favorisant l’égalité, la diversité et l’inclusion. Toutes les candidatures sans aucune distinction (âge, handicap, sexe, nationalité, religion, orientation sexuelle…) ont leur place dans notre processus de recrutement. Présentation de l’Ecole : ENSTA est membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris) . Dans le cadre d’IP Paris, l’école participe aux activités des centres interdisciplinaires notamment du centre interdisciplinaire d'études pour la Défense et la Sécurité (CIEDS, soutenu par le ministère des armées et l’agence de l’innovation de défense (AID). Elle est à l’origine de la création du Centre interdisciplinaire Mers & Océans , inauguré en janvier 2025. Des chercheurs de l’école travaillent également en collaboration dans le cadre d'études portées par les centres Hi-Paris, lauréat en 2024 IA Cluster, E4C ou E4H notamment. ENSTA résulte de la fusion le 1er janvier 2025 d’ENSTA Paris et d’ENSTA Bretagne. Son siège est situé à Palaiseau (91), sur le campus de Paris-Saclay et elle a un autre campus à Brest. Elle met en place une nouvelle formation d’ingénieur unifiée sur les deux campus (Paris-Saclay et Brest) à la rentrée académique 2026/2027. Rejoindre l'école, c'est intégrer un établissement engagé pour la parité et l'égalité professionnelle, la diversité et l'accompagnement de ses agents en situation de handicap , dès le recrutement et tout au long de la carrière. Afin de préserver le bien-être au travail, l'école mène une politique active en matière de conditions de travail, reposant notamment sur un juste équilibre entre vie personnelle et vie professionnelle.
