title: Software Engineer Intern (2027) - Austin, TX
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations</strong></p> <ul> <li>Austin, US</li> </ul> <p><strong>Available Terms</strong></p> <ul> <li>Winter/Spring (January - May 2027) </li> <li>Summer (May - September 2027)</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>Anytime we push code, it automatically affects the millions of Internet properties (powering websites, remote teams, APIs, mobile apps, etc.) running on our global network. Cloudflare's network is one of the largest in the world and spans over 330 cities in more than 125 countries. What's more, Cloudflare operates within 50 milliseconds of 95% of the Internet-connected population globally (for context, the blink of an eye is 300-400 milliseconds!). We are passionate about making the Internet more secure, reliable, and faster for everyone.</p> <p>Cloudflare’s Engineering teams build and run the software that handles the massive amount of traffic that flows through our network. We also have teams that build the UI and control plane for our software, using modern patterns and libraries in a microservices-based architecture. Technologies include: Typescript/Javascript, Go, Rust, C/C++ and Python.</p> <p>The ideal intern is passionate about making the Internet a better place. You will work alongside experienced engineers. You will push code this internship that touches hundreds of millions of web surfers. We like to get things done, so we are looking for interns who are curious, proactive, and able to complete projects. This is a great opportunity for engineers who want to learn to develop at Internet scale.</p> <p>You can check out our <a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/tag/internship-experience/">internship blogs</a> to learn more about our program and hear directly from our past interns.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ship and deliver projects over 12-14 weeks with autonomy and support.</li> <li>Work cross-functionally with various teams.</li> <li>Work closely with a mentor to guide you through the internship and help with career goals.</li> <li>Build your network across the company through our various in and out of office socials, networking programs, Employee Resource Group (ERG) programs, and Activity Groups.</li> <li>Present your project to the entire company at the end of the internship.</li> <li>Connect and learn from our executives and leadership team including our co-founders.</li> <li>Learn and develop skills through our professional development workshops.</li> <li>Write for our <a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/">Cloudflare blog</a> and be featured on <a href="http://cloudflare.tv/">Cloudflare.tv</a> sessions. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Currently pursuing a degree or program in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics or relevant field to the role.</li> <li>Demonstrated critical thinking skills and drive to learn and adapt new technologies.</li> <li>Curiosity, empathy and ability to get things done.</li> <li>Ability to commit to a full-time (40 hours/week Monday - Friday) for a minimum 12 week internship.</li> <li>In office 3-5 days a week in Austin, TX.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points</strong></p> <p>Demonstrated passion for software development, such as personal projects, open-source contributions, or experience with our developer platform using <a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/students/">Cloudflare for Students.</a></p> <p><strong>Please note</strong></p> <ul> <li>We will be hiring interns on a rolling basis until all roles are filled.</li> <li>We are not considering remote or part-time for either terms. This is a full-time (40hr/week internship) with in-person expectations; standard business hours are typically 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM. description: At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. The phone call, the contact form, the support ticket: all of it is being replaced by messaging and AI. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams. In this role you own all of finance at Superchat end to end and report directly to the founders. When the board or our investors have a question about the numbers, you're the one who answers it. You'll take over our financial model and turn it into something the whole company can steer by. You'll own accounting through to the P&L, run forecasting and liquidity planning, and lead the annual audit. Who We Want 7+ years of finance experience. You know the full cycle first-hand, from closing to forecast to board reporting. Closing and audit expertise. You independently own monthly and annual closings under HGB, including revenue recognition and accruals, and you coordinate the annual audit with our external auditors through to completed financial statements. Expert financial modelling. You build driver-based, integrated three-statement models from scratch and you document them so that others can operate them too. Forecasting. functions running predictably, so none of them relies on any one person working unsustainable hours.</li> <li>Represent all three functions to peer engineering stakeholders, and step in front of customers directly when Platform Staff is engaged mid-crisis.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Working knowledge of GitLab's development workflows and platform If they go sideways in production, they affect everything downstream, including continuous integration, code review, and deployments. This role starts with genuine subject matter expertise in Git technologies and extends to reliable operation across GitLab's deployment models: Self-Managed, GitLab Dedicated, and SaaS.</p> <p>You'll build and develop a team with deep platform expertise and strong operational judgment. You'll partner across engineering groups to shape how Git and Gitaly operations evolve as the platform grows.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Build and lead a team with deep platform expertise in Git and Gitaly, hiring and developing engineers who can operate this infrastructure layer with strong operational judgment.</li> <li>Own production reliability for Git and Gitaly must differ between them.</li> <li>Maintain cloud-agnostic architecture and tooling decisions, avoiding designs that assume a single hyperscaler's primitives.</li> <li>Partner with the teams that own each deployment model so operational practices stay coherent rather than fragmenting into separate playbooks.</li> <li>Apply distributed systems fundamentals, including consistency, replication, and failure domains, to Gitaly's storage and replication model.</li> <li>Own elastic storage and compute strategy for Git repository data, including capacity planning, autoscaling, and consumption-based provisioning for GitLab's largest self-managed and SaaS customers.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Familiarity with GitLab's product and deployment models, and how Git and Gitaly support repository operations across self-managed, dedicated, and SaaS environments.</li> <li>Hands-on subject matter expertise in Git internals, including how the protocol, object model, and storage layer behave under load and at scale, not only familiarity with Git usage.</li> <li>Strong distributed systems fundamentals, including consistency, replication, failure handling, and horizontal scalability.</li> <li>Experience running production infrastructure across multiple deployment models, such as self-managed, dedicated or single-tenant, and multi-tenant SaaS, or a credible path from adjacent experience to it.</li> <li>Experience with elastic storage and compute, and consumption-based system design for variable, unpredictable load.</li> <li>People management experience, ideally leading site reliability engineering-style or platform operations teams.</li> <li>Direct experience with Gitaly, libgit2, JGit, or another Git implementation's internals is advantageous.</li> Gitaly Operations team to go deep on one of GitLab's most critical platforms. <li class="li3">Participate in hiring by reviewing applications and assessments and joining interviews to help grow the Support team.</li> </ul> <p class="p1"><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></p> Rails.</li> <li class="li3">Hands-on experience with Git and CI/CD in production or customer environments.</li> <li class="li3">Skill in writing clear, accurate support content and documentation based supply-chain problem.</li> <li><strong>Own What You Build in Production:</strong> Take part in on-call and incident response for the systems your teams own, act as a technical escalation point during Adoption:</strong> Lead team-level adoption of AI-assisted and agentic workflows, including the quality, security, privacy, and operational guardrails, and help engineers direct, validate, reject, and course-correct agent output.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Cross-Team Technical Leadership:</strong> A sustained record of technical leadership across more than one team or a broad product area.</li> <li><strong>Deep Architecture Experience:</strong> Deep backend architecture and production experience in complex applications, services, or platforms, including scaling or governing APIs, service platforms, data systems, modular monoliths, or shared backend components.</li> <li><strong>Modularization in Production:</strong> Experience modernizing a monolith or legacy backend architecture in production, and with modular architecture such as bounded contexts, package encapsulation, ports and adapters, service extraction, event-driven boundaries, or an equivalent approach.</li> <li><strong>Influence Without Authority:</strong> A strong ability to create alignment through clear written proposals and decision records, so decisions are documented, understood, and adopted without constant escalation.</li> <li><strong>Product Judgment:</strong> The ability to balance customer outcomes, delivery speed, technical health, reliability, and long-term platform investment.</li> <li><strong>Mentorship:</strong> Experience mentoring engineers and shaping standards through code review, documentation, and example.</li> <li><strong>Agentic AI Leadership:</strong> Production experience with AI-assisted or agentic engineering workflows, including the ability to evaluate and improve how a team adopts them.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Helpful title: Senior Customer Engineer, Commercial
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. strategic customer advisory.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Experience:</strong> Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Sales Engineering, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer (years of experience required will vary based on Associate, Senior, Staff, or Principal leveling).</li> <li><strong>Technical Acumen:</strong> Broad technical expertise spanning web security, networking (routing, DNS, DDoS mitigation), cloud infrastructure, and enterprise architecture.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Mindset:</strong> Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, title: Data Protection & AI Governance Advisor (m/w/d)
description: Your mission Datenschutz Du unterstützt unsere Business Funktionen bei der Dokumentation ihrer Verarbeitungsprozessen und pflegst die Verzeichnisse nach Art. 30 Abs. 1 + 2 DSGVO. Du erstellst Datenschutz-Folgenabschätzungen, Legitimate Interest Assessments und Transfer Impact Assessments. Du berätst die Fachbereiche zur datenschutzrechtlichen Ausgestaltung unserer SaaS-Produkte und internen Prozesse – insbesondere zu Datenminimierung, Mandantentrennung, Berechtigungskonzepten, Löschung und Privacy by Design. Du prüfst Auftragsverarbeitungsverträge und führst Vorabprüfungen neuer Dienstleister und KI-Tools durch. Du betreibst das Datenschutzmanagementsystem: Du pflegst Richtlinien und Vorlagen, führst Kontrollen durch, überwachst Abhilfemaßnahmen und verwaltest unsere Datenschutz- und KI-Governanceplattform. AI Governance Du baust das Inventar unserer KI-Systeme auf und pflegst es, bereitest die Einordnung nach Art. 6 und Anhang III AI Act vor und bestimmst unsere Rolle als Anbieter oder Betreiber. Du wirkst am Freigabeprozess für KI-Vorhaben mit und entwickelst Prüfkriterien, Gates und Entscheidungsvorlagen. Du erstellst die Pflichtdokumentation zu Risikomanagement, Daten-Governance und Bias-Prüfung, technischer Dokumentation, menschlicher Aufsicht, Protokollierung sowie Transparenzpflichten. Du prüfst KI-Modelle und -Dienste auf vertragliche Zusagen zu Trainingsnutzung, Datenhaltung und Vereinbarkeit mit unseren Kundenzusagen. So arbeiten wir zusammen Du wirst Teil eines kleinen, schlagkräftigen Teams, das pragmatisch denkt und eng mit Produkt, Engineering und Legal zusammenarbeitet. Wir schätzen offenen Austausch, kurze Wege und die gemeinsame Freude daran, komplexe Regulatorik in praktikable Lösungen zu übersetzen. Your profile Du bringst mindestens drei Jahre Berufserfahrung im Datenschutz mit, davon substanziell in einer Second-Line-Funktion – etwa als Datenschutzkoordinator, im Datenschutzmanagement, in einer Compliance- oder Governance-Einheit oder in einer externen Beratungsrolle mit vergleichbarem Prüfauftrag. Du hast Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Datenschutz-Folgenabschätzungen, Legitimate Interest Assessments und Transfer Impact Assessments. title: Principal, EMEA Sales Strategy and Operations
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: London, the UK</strong></p> <p><strong>About the Role: </strong></p> <p>As the Principal, EMEA Sales Strategy and Operations, you will lead the operational strategy and execution for two of our most important regions in EMEA. Reporting directly to the Senior Director of Sales Strategy and Operation for EMEA, you will partner closely with regional sales leadership, global sales operations, marketing, finance, and other cross-functional teams to drive sales productivity, accelerate pipeline growth, and enhance forecasting accuracy.</p> <p>You will identify, design, and execute strategies that improve performance, scalability, and operational excellence across UKI, CEE and Israel regions. A catalyst for action, you will bring structure, insight, and momentum to a rapidly growing business. The ideal candidate is both process- and data-driven, thrives on collaboration, and knows how to unite teams around a common vision to deliver exceptional results. </p> <h4><strong>What you'll do</strong></h4> <ul> <li> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Serve as a business partner to the UKI, CEE and Israel AVPs and Sales Leadership team, defining and driving strategic initiatives that enable the region to achieve its quarterly and annual revenue objectives. You will deliver actionable insights, analytics, and use AI to enhance decision-making, uncover performance bottlenecks, and accelerate sales execution</li> <li>You will work to continuously improve processes, innovate and find scalable solutions to do more with less. You will use AI and automation to improve sales productivity and help leadership look behind corners to anticipate blockers and reduce risks. </li> <li>Partner with other Regional Leaders, global RevOps, Marketing Ops, Finance and Enablement to ensure regional execution aligns with global go-to-market strategy and expectations</li> <li>Drive forecasting discipline: ensure accurate pipeline coverage, risk identification, deal reviews, and business reviews with regional leadership</li> <li>Monitor region-specific market dynamics and ensure sales operations are tailored to the unique UKI, CEE and Israel environment</li> <li>Own key regional sales operations metrics (e.g., sales cycle length, win rate, pipeline conversion, average deal size, forecasting accuracy, quota attainment) and provide regular reporting to senior leadership and support EMEA sales Strategy and Operations leader to improve cadences.</li> <li>Partner with GTM strategy team and provide input to sales planning, including regular updates to quotas, customer segmentation, account targeting, and Channel development</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <h4><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Proven senior experience (10+ years) in sales operations, revenue operations or go-to-market operations in a high-growth technology / SaaS company </li> <li>Experience scaling sales operations across multiple regions (preferably EMEA) including complexity of multiple countries, languages, regulatory frameworks</li> <li>Strong analytical skills and comfort working with data: able to turn data into insights and actions</li> <li>Deep understanding of sales processes/end-to-end sales lifecycle, pipeline management best practices, forecasting, territory/quota design, incentive comp, CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce)</li> <li>Experience to use AI to drive automation, innovation and improve efficiency.</li> <li>Exceptional cross-functional collaboration and influencing skills: ability to partner with sales leadership, marketing, product, finance, enablement and others</li> <li>Excellent communication (verbal & written) — able to articulate complex operational issues and influence senior leadership</li> <li>Comfortable working in fast-paced, dynamic, changing environment; strong change-management aptitude</li> <li>Strategic thinking with strong execution orientation</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Senior Frontend Engineer (Berlin)
description: GeneralMind builds AI Systems of Action for complex enterprise workflows. title: (Junior) Accountant (m/w/d)
description: Über Holidu Holidu ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Tech-Unternehmen für Ferienvermietung weltweit. Unser Ziel: Ferienunterkünfte sollen sich sorgenfrei buchen und vermieten lassen und dabei einfach Freude machen. Dafür helfen wir Gastgeber*innen, mit weniger Aufwand mehr Buchungen zu erzielen, und Gästen, genau die Ferienunterkunft zu finden, in der sie sich rundum wohlfühlen. Bei uns arbeiten rund 700 Kolleg*innen aus über 60 Nationen. Uns verbinden die Leidenschaft für Technologie, der Anspruch, jeden Tag ein Stück besser zu werden, und der Antrieb, mehr als 40.000 Gastgeber*innen und 4 Millionen Gästen im Jahr das bestmögliche Erlebnis zu bieten. Dein Team Unser Finance-Team kümmert sich um die Zahlen hinter der schnell wachsenden Reiseplattform. In der Buchhaltung sind wir rund 15 Kolleg*innen und verantworten aktuell mehr als zehn Gesellschaften im In- und Ausland, Tendenz steigend. Bei uns lernst du das Handwerk der Buchhaltung von erfahrenen Kolleg*innen von Grund auf und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung; in welche Richtung, das gestaltest du mit deinen Stärken und Interessen. Weil wir wirklich als Team arbeiten, kommt der Spaß dabei nicht zu kurz, im Alltag wie bei unseren Teamevents. Deine Aufgaben Du übernimmst Aufgaben der Finanzbuchhaltung, insbesondere in der Kreditorenbuchhaltung im operativen Tagesgeschäft: du bearbeitest unser Buchhaltungspostfach, erfasst und verbuchst Rechnungen, bereitest Zahlläufe vor, unterstützt bei der laufenden Kontenabstimmung und -pflege und klärst kleinere Differenzen zunehmend selbstständig. Du wirkst bei unseren Monats- und Jahresabschlüssen mit. Du unterstützt bei Projekten zum Beispiel bei der Prozessoptimierung in der Buchhaltung Du hilfst mit, unsere Buchhaltung Schritt für Schritt schlauer zu machen, zum Beispiel mit Excel oder KI. Du entwickelst dich Schritt für Schritt weiter und gestaltest deine Zukunft bei uns aktiv mit. Dein Profil Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung, z. B. als Steuerfachangestellte*r, oder ein betriebswirtschaftliches Studium mit Schwerpunkt Finanzbuchhaltung / Rechnungswesen. Du hast bereits erste Berufserfahrung in der Buchhaltung gesammelt, zum Beispiel im Rahmen deiner Ausbildung, eines Praktikums oder einer Werkstudententätigkeit. Du bringst gute Kenntnisse in der Rechnungslegung mit und kennst die Grundlagen der Buchhaltung; in neue Themen arbeitest du dich mit Freude ein. Du arbeitest sicher mit Excel Kenntnisse von Buchhaltungssystemen wie SAP sind von Vorteil Du bist offen für den Einsatz von KI und hast Freude daran, wiederkehrende Aufgaben schlauer zu lösen. Du arbeitest verlässlich, genau und strukturiert, bringst analytisches Denken mit und schaust gerne über den Tellerrand, um bestehende Prozesse zu hinterfragen und zu verbessern. Du hast Spaß an der Arbeit in einem dynamischen, schnellen Umfeld und bringst Eigenmotivation und Einsatzbereitschaft mit, um wirklich etwas zu bewegen. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. We are redefining developer acquisition in a world where AI and distributed agents are reshaping the stack. Our mission is to create accessible and exciting pathways for developers to discover Cloudflare—whether through ecosystem partnerships, high-impact content, or creative field engagement.</p> <p>We are a diverse team of builders, storytellers, and connectors united by one goal: to make Cloudflare the most empowering and exciting place for developers to build.</p> <h3><strong>About the Role</strong></h3> <p>As a Principal Solutions Architect for the Developer Platform, you will shape and guide the regional technical strategy for our most strategic customer and partner engagements across APJC and Greater China.</p> <p>In this senior role, you will partner closely with engineering leaders, architects, developers, security teams, and executives to define architectures, validate technical approaches, and confidently transition production workloads onto Cloudflare. entire team.</li> <li>Empowered the field organization’s ability to position, architect, and deliver Cloudflare’s developer and AI solutions.</li> <li>Cultivated the technical leadership of your colleagues through active mentorship and enablement.</li> <li>Provided product teams with consistent, evidence-based insights into regional customer requirements and adoption barriers.</li> <li>Become recognized as a supportive, authoritative Principal Developer Platform architect across APJC.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What We’re Looking For</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Meaningful Experience:</strong> A strong background in solutions architecture, software engineering, technical consulting, or a related customer-facing technical role. <li><strong>Language Skills:</strong> Professional fluency in English and Mandarin Chinese, with the ability to comfortably lead technical and executive discussions in both languages to support clients in the Greater China region, which form a significant part of your portfolio.</li> <li><strong>Strategic Collaboration:</strong> A track record of guiding complex technical strategies involving developers, infrastructure teams, security stakeholders, and senior executives.</li> <li><strong>Technical Depth:</strong> Deep working knowledge of distributed application architecture title: Software Engineer, Robot Autonomy (Planning & Navigation)
description: Our Mission At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient. We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today! THE ROLE As a Software Engineer on Robot Autonomy, you will make our robots navigate dependably across real customer sites. Our stack works. The gap between working and dependable is the whole job. Every new site tests how a robot understands its surroundings and chooses where to go: a ramp the planner avoids, a narrow passage that exposes a poor route, a gate that changes the map, a person who steps into the robot's path, or localization drift that builds over a long patrol. You treat those cases as the real navigation problem to solve, not as edge cases. You'll shape the technical choices behind reliable navigation, from sensor selection, ground segmentation, and traversability estimation to predicting how people and vehicles move and planning safe, efficient routes around them. The system has to work day and night, in challenging weather, across different embodiments and changing site conditions. We measure success by whether the robot completes its patrol on a live site, not by how it performs in simulation. WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON Navigation and path-planning design: how robots represent traversable space, select routes, avoid obstacles, and reach goals across complex sites. Sensor integration driven by navigation requirements, including what ground segmentation and traversability estimation need in day, night, and challenging weather. Environment understanding: how the robot distinguishes ground from obstacles and estimates which terrain is safe and practical to traverse. Behavior prediction: anticipate how people, vehicles, and other dynamic obstacles will move, and plan routes that stay safe and efficient around them. Field reliability: reproduce failures from deployments, find the root cause, and fix it at the right layer, from sensor data and maps to costmaps, planners, and recovery behaviors. Planning under imperfect localization: plans that stay useful when the state estimate drifts and the robot must execute routes in tight or dynamic environments, working with the rest of Robot Autonomy on localization and control. Validation on real robots: logs, simulation, and repeatable field tests to verify that design choices and changes hold across routes, lighting, weather, and site layouts. New autonomy capabilities: work with the engineers building the operator application and backend so operator requests and new robot capabilities rest on a sound navigation design. The field feedback loop: work closely with forward-deployed engineers to turn site issues into bugs, design changes, and improvements to the navigation stack. Regular site visits to build a practical understanding of how robots and sensors behave in real operating conditions. WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR We're looking for an engineer who has taken a robotics system from unreliable to dependable and takes ownership beyond individual tickets. You can explain why you made a navigation design choice and what it costs. When a robot takes a bad route, you can tell whether the planner, the map, the state estimate, or the robot's behavior is at fault, and you fix the right one. You are comfortable in the field and want to understand how robots behave in real customer environments. YOUR BACKGROUND: A Master's degree or PhD in mechanical engineering, computer science, robotics, electrical engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Proven track record building and deploying navigation on ground mobile robots in the real world (3+ years or equivalent depth). Hands-on experience with mobile robot navigation and path planning: route or local planning, static and dynamic obstacle avoidance, costmaps, or recovery behaviors. Understanding of how mapping and localization affect navigation, and the ability to diagnose when a planning issue is actually caused by the map, the state estimate, or robot behavior. Understanding of how lighting, weather, terrain, and sensor limitations affect perception and navigation, with experience developing or validating systems for demanding real-world conditions. Hands-on experience with robotics sensors and hardware, especially LiDAR, IMUs, and cameras. You can investigate issues across software, networking, and hardware boundaries. Experience testing and debugging navigation on physical robots using logs, visualization, simulation, and repeatable field tests. Strong ROS 2, C++, and Python skills. Clear communication of navigation and path-planning design choices and their trade-offs. Willingness to visit customer sites regularly. NICE TO HAVE: Experience with legged robots or with more than one robot embodiment. Experience with Nav2 or a comparable navigation framework. Motion prediction or planning among people and vehicles, such as trajectory forecasting or socially aware navigation. Terrain mapping and traversability methods: elevation mapping, learned traversability, or semantic segmentation for navigation. Experience with night-time or all-weather sensing, such as thermal cameras or LiDAR in rain and fog. Background in security, defence, or other safety-critical robotics deployments. What We Offer Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end. Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence. Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow. Team: work directly with PhD-level co-founders in AI, Robotics, and Physics, alongside a strong (and fun) founding team. Compensation: Competitive equity/salary package Culture: International founding team that is serious about building but does not take itself too seriously. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

description: Our Mission At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today! THE ROLE As a Software Engineer on Robot Autonomy, you will build and own the state estimation that tells our robots how they are moving and where they are. You'll fuse data from IMUs, cameras, LiDAR, GNSS, and platform-specific odometry into accurate, real-time estimates that support reliable autonomy day and night, across different robot platforms. This is a builder's role first: you'll use the estimation methods and tools best suited to the problem, then do the engineering needed to make them work on real robots. Our robots operate in complex environments where terrain, weather, vibration, lighting, and sensor dropouts degrade measurements. description: Location: Hybrid, Zürich (2-3 days in office) About what. AG We're a Zurich-based digital consultancy with 40+ ambitious, kind specialists. title: Social Media Strategy Director
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>San Francisco, CA | Austin, TX | New York City, NY</p> <h4><strong>About the role</strong></h4> <p>We are looking for a Social Media Strategy Director to redefine how Cloudflare shows up online. In this role, you will think like a storyteller—transforming our deep data pools, research, and corporate milestones into a sophisticated, multi-platform strategy. You will oversee global social media, executive digital positioning, web-based storytelling, and community-driven engagement to build a cohesive, influential, and authentic digital brand.</p> <p>You are a visionary storyteller, a sharp strategist, and an Internet-native thinker. You understand that how we communicate on GitHub, Reddit, Hacker News, and YouTube matters just as much as a headline in The Wall Street Journal. This role isn't just about managing a content calendar; it’s about strategically deploying Cloudflare's voice on LinkedIn, X, and via digital assets to influence enterprise buyers, developers, tech policy leaders, and the global business community.</p> <p>If you understand Internet subcultures, appreciate a great tech meme, and know how to foster genuine developer loyalty at scale, this is your sandbox.</p> <h4><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Architect the Digital Strategy:</strong> Define the overarching vision for Cloudflare’s corporate digital channels, ensuring our voice is distinct, authoritative, and deeply understood by tech-savvy audiences and enterprise buyers alike.</li> <li><strong>Elevate Executive Positioning:</strong> Partner directly with our executive leadership team to shape and scale their personal digital brands, turning complex industry trends into compelling online narratives.</li> <li><strong>Drive Multi-Channel Storytelling: </strong>Manage our corporate social media channels (X/Twitter, LinkedIn, YouTube, etc.) while expanding our strategic footprint into emerging platforms and technical communities.</li> <li><strong>Bridge Tech and Culture:</strong> Translate highly complex technical milestones—from network infrastructure to post-quantum cryptography—into creative, engaging, and accessible digital content.</li> <li><strong>Crisis & Rapid Response: </strong>Act as a critical node in our crisis management engine. $234,000</span></li> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For New York based hires: Estimated annual salary o $163,000 - $224,000 </span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. title: Senior Consultant (Strategy & Data/AI Transformation)
description: <h2>Who is Artefact?</h2> <p>Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm dedicated to transforming organisations through data and AI. We combine the rigour of top-tier strategy consulting with deep expertise in data, digital and analytics to help clients achieve tangible business impact.</p> <p>With 2,500+ consultants, data scientists and engineers, we work with global leaders such as Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange and Sanofi. Our Swiss offices are at the heart of Artefact’s growth, advising clients on their most pressing strategic challenges — from AI strategy and governance to digital transformation roadmaps and new business model design.</p> <h2>Main Responsibilities</h2> <p>As a Senior Consultant in our Zurich/Lausanne office, you will work at the intersection of strategy consulting and data and AI delivery. You will:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Strategy Development:</strong> Work with client leadership teams to address high-stakes questions. How can AI reshape our business model? How should we govern and organise for data? Which strategic programmes deliver the most impact?</li> <li><strong>Structured Problem-Solving:</strong> Break complex challenges down into decisions a client can act on, combining consulting rigour with a working knowledge of what current AI can and cannot actually do.</li> <li><strong>Solution Design:</strong> Turn a business question into a solution shape — what data it depends on, what kind of platform or product it should sit on, and what “good” looks like once it is built. You will do this alongside our data scientists and engineers.</li> <li><strong>Project Delivery:</strong> Support engagements end to end, from hypothesis framing and market and competitor analysis through to data maturity assessments, client workshops, governance design and implementation roadmaps.</li> <li><strong>Client Engagement:</strong> Work closely with C-level stakeholders and business unit leaders. You will build trusted relationships, communicate recommendations with clarity, and keep the work aligned to what the client is actually trying to decide.</li> <li><strong>Knowledge & Practice Building:</strong> Contribute to the growth of Artefact's Zurich office by shaping new offerings, creating intellectual capital - frameworks, thought pieces, benchmarks - and taking part in business development.</li> </ul> <h2>Candidate Profile</h2> <p>We are looking for someone who can hold a technical position and a commercial one at the same time. The strongest candidates meet most of the following.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Education:</strong> A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Business, Economics or a related field.</li> <li><strong>Work Experience:</strong> Around three to five years in consulting, or in a technical/date-focussed role with client-facing responsibility. </li> <li><strong>Business Acumen & AI Fluency:</strong> A genuine dual affinity for business and technology. You are comfortable with modern data and AI concepts - generative AI and LLMs, retrieval, predictive machine learning, cloud platforms - and with what they cost and where they fail, not only with what they are called.</li> <li><strong>Technical Depth:</strong> You have built AI or data products, not only advised on them. You can explain why you chose which model you put on which part of the work, and what that choice did to both output quality and cost. You will not be writing production code in this role, but you should have the basic understanding.</li> <li><strong>Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills:</strong> Strong quantitative and analytical skills, and the judgement to know which number actually decides the question. You are comfortable getting to a defensible estimate with your assumptions stated out loud.</li> <li><strong>Communication & Interpersonal Skills:</strong> Excellent written and verbal communication. You enjoy working in teams and in front of clients.</li> <li><strong>Languages:</strong> Fluency in German/French and English, written and spoken, is strongly preferred.. </li> <li><strong>Work Eligibility:</strong> You must be eligible to work in Switzerland.</li> </ul> <h2>Why Join Us</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Strategy and the Build:</strong> Artefact is neither a traditional strategy consultancy nor a pure technology player. You will move between the boardroom and the build, and be expected to be credible in both.</li> <li><strong>Engineers, not hand-offs:</strong> Our 2,500 people include the data scientists and engineers you will work beside on the same engagement - not a delivery organisation you hand a slide deck to.</li> <li><strong>Zurich Office Impact:</strong> As part of a growing Swiss team you will have visibility and impact from the first day. You will help shape Artefact's footprint in the region and work directly with senior leadership.</li> <li><strong>Learning & Growth:</strong> Regular training in both consulting method and AI and data capability, combined with international exposure.</li> <li><strong>Culture of Doers:</strong> Innovation, action, collaboration. We are entrepreneurial and fast-moving, committed to delivering impact while supporting each other's growth.</li> </ul> <p>This position is based in <strong>Zürich or Lausanne</strong>.</p> Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Engagement Manager (Strategy & Data/AI Transformation)
description: <h2>Who is Artefact?</h2> <p>Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm dedicated to transforming organisations through data and AI. We combine the rigour of top-tier strategy consulting with deep expertise in data, digital and analytics to help clients achieve tangible business impact.</p> <p>With 2,500+ consultants, data scientists and engineers, we work with global leaders such as Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange and Sanofi. Our Zurich office is at the heart of Artefact’s growth, advising clients on their most pressing strategic challenges — from AI strategy and governance to digital transformation roadmaps and new business model design.</p> <h2>Main Responsibilities</h2> <p>As an Engagement Manager in our Zurich or Lausanne office, you will work at the intersection of strategy consulting and data and AI delivery. You will:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Strategy Development:</strong> Work with client leadership teams to address high-stakes questions. How can AI reshape our business model? How should we govern and organise for data? Which strategic programmes deliver the most impact?</li> <li><strong>Structured Problem-Solving:</strong> Break complex challenges down into decisions a client can act on, combining consulting rigour with a working knowledge of what current AI can and cannot actually do.</li> <li><strong>Solution Design:</strong> Turn a business question into a solution shape — what data it depends on, what kind of platform or product it should sit on, and what “good” looks like once it is built. You will do this alongside our data scientists and engineers, and you will be accountable for whether the design survives contact with production.</li> <li><strong>Project Delivery:</strong> Run engagements end to end, from hypothesis framing and market and competitor analysis through to data maturity assessments, client workshops, governance design and implementation roadmaps.</li> <li><strong>Feasibility & Economics:</strong> Own the answer to "will this work, and what will it cost". The evaluation approach, the unit economics per query or per case, and the point at which the business case stops closing.</li> <li><strong>Client Engagement:</strong> Work closely with C-level stakeholders and business unit leaders. You will build trusted relationships, communicate recommendations with clarity, and keep the work aligned to what the client is actually trying to decide.</li> <li><strong>Team Leadership:</strong> Lead mixed teams of consultants, data scientists and engineers. You are the person who can tell whether the technical plan is realistic, and the person the client believes when you say that it is.</li> <li><strong>Knowledge & Practice Building:</strong> Contribute to the growth of Artefact's Zurich and Lausanne offices by shaping new offerings, creating intellectual capital - frameworks, thought pieces, benchmarks - and taking part in business development.</li> </ul> <h2>Candidate Profile</h2> <p>We are looking for someone who can hold a technical position and a commercial one at the same time, and lead a team through both. The strongest candidates meet most of the following.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Education:</strong> A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Business, Economics or a related field. A strong technical foundation counts for more with us than where you studied.</li> <li><strong>Work Experience:</strong> Five to eight years across consulting and technology delivery, including at least one dedicated AI or data project.</li> <li><strong>Business Acumen & AI Fluency:</strong> A strong dual affinity for business and technology. You have a deep working understanding of modern data and AI concepts — generative AI and LLMs, retrieval, predictive machine learning, cloud architectures — and of their practical business applications. You are capable of scoping AI use cases and of discussing technical constraints and opportunities confidently with C-level stakeholders.</li> <li><strong>Technical Depth:</strong> You have owned the technical shape of AI work, not only its business case. You think in terms of enterprise architecture — how a solution fits the existing landscape, what it needs from data and governance, and how it scales from pilot to full rollout — and can defend those choices to technical and commercial stakeholders alike. You will not be writing production code, but you should have been close enough to it to be credible with the engineers with which you will collaborate.</li> <li><strong>Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills:</strong> Strong quantitative and analytical skills, and the judgement to know which number actually decides the question. You are comfortable getting to a defensible estimate with your assumptions stated out loud.</li> <li><strong>Communication & Interpersonal Skills:</strong> Excellent written and verbal communication. You can take a technical trade-off to a non-technical sponsor without flattening it, and be challenged by an engineer without retreating into abstraction. You enjoy working in teams and in front of clients.</li> <li><strong>Languages:</strong> Fluency in German/French and English, written and spoken, is strongly preferred. </li> <li><strong>Work Eligibility:</strong> You must be eligible to work in Switzerland.</li> </ul> <h2>Why Join Us</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Strategy and the Build:</strong> Artefact is neither a traditional strategy consultancy nor a pure technology player. You will move between the boardroom and the build, and be expected to be credible in both.</li> <li><strong>Engineers, not hand-offs:</strong> Our 2,500 people include the data scientists and engineers you will work beside on the same engagement - not a delivery organisation you hand a slide deck to.</li> <li><strong>Zurich Office Impact:</strong> As part of a growing Swiss team you will have visibility and impact from the first day. You will help shape Artefact's footprint in the region and work directly with senior leadership.</li> <li><strong>Learning & Growth:</strong> Regular training in both consulting method and AI and data capability, combined with international exposure.</li> <li><strong>Culture of Doers:</strong> Innovation, action, collaboration. We are entrepreneurial and fast-moving, committed to delivering impact while supporting each other's growth.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p>This position is based in <strong>Zürich or Lausanne</strong>.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Customer Solutions Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p data-path-to-node="1"><strong>Official Title - Center of Excellence Engineer</strong></p> <p data-path-to-node="1"><strong>Available Locations: Bengaluru, India</strong></p> <p data-path-to-node="2"><strong>About the Role:-</strong></p> <p data-path-to-node="2">As a Center of Excellence Engineer (Customer Solutions Engineer), you will provide technical guidance to Cloudflare customers. Working within the GTM organization and reporting to a Center of Excellence Leader, the Center of Excellence Engineer (CEE) helps Cloudflare customers and internal teams through structured onboarding, technical guidance, adoption support, and scalable enablement. You will guide customers as they move from provisioned accounts to a live, value-generating deployment. You are a Cloudflare product expert and will leverage your knowledge to ensure our customers understand and utilize the Cloudflare platform to its fullest extent. This is a customer-facing technical role focused on post-sale onboarding, technical advisory, 1:1 technical engagements and 1:many technical events. You will be collaborating with CEs, AEs, Support and other internal teams to ensure no customer falls through the cracks.</p> <p data-path-to-node="3"><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li data-path-to-node="4">Customer Onboarding and Deployment Readiness: Own the end-to-end technical onboarding experience for assigned customers post-provision. Lead structured onboarding calls, guide customers to configure initial Cloudflare settings (e.g., DNS records, SSL/TLS modes, WAF rules, Zero Trust policies), and validate that traffic is behaving as expected before the customer is declared live. Guide customers through onboarding and implementation runbooks and identify when an engagement requires escalation to the appropriate Cloudflare team. Troubleshoot common onboarding issues including DNS resolution failures, SSL/TLS certificate errors, caching misconfigurations, and authentication failures.</li> <li data-path-to-node="5">Cloudflare Configuration Guidance: Guide customers through Cloudflare configuration steps for applicable platform capabilities, including DNS, SSL/TLS, CDN, Application Security, Zero Trust/SASE, Network Services, and other Cloudflare products as assigned. Help customers understand configuration options, operational best practices, and standard deployment patterns.</li> <li data-path-to-node="6">Customer Technical Guidance and Enablement: Deliver standardized customer guidance sessions, technical walkthroughs, workshops, bootcamps, 1:1 technical engagements and 1:many technical sessions covering Cloudflare product specific best practices, migration procedures, and post-deployment administration. Explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical customer stakeholders.</li> <li data-path-to-node="7">Documentation and Engagement Hygiene: Produce and maintain clear technical and operational artifacts, including call summaries, action item trackers, onboarding plans, runbooks, and handoff materials. Keep relevant internal systems updated after customer touchpoints and maintain high-quality documentation for continuity across teams.</li> <li data-path-to-node="8">Cross-Functional Coordination and Escalation Management: Coordinate with Cloudflare Customer Engineering, Support, Product, Engineering, Account, and other internal teams to route complex technical issues, document blockers, support escalations, and maintain continuity of customer outcomes.</li> <li data-path-to-node="9">Operational Improvement and Knowledge Sharing: Contribute to reusable templates, procedures, technical guides, internal knowledge articles, automation scripts, AI-assisted workflows, and process improvements that improve the quality, consistency, and efficiency of customer onboarding and customer engineering activities.</li> <li data-path-to-node="10">Technical Breadth and Continuous Development: Build and maintain working knowledge across Cloudflare product foundations, including Application Security, CDN, Zero Trust/SASE, and Network Services, at a depth appropriate to onboarding, adoption, troubleshooting, and technical advisory scenarios. Stay current on Cloudflare product releases, internal process updates, and relevant certifications. Be familiar with and leverage AI technology available to you to create new and innovative tools to support your work.</li> </ul> <p data-path-to-node="11"><strong>Minimum Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul data-path-to-node="12"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="12,0,0">5-12 years of experience in a customer-facing technical role such as Customer Engineer, Technical Support, Implementation Engineer, Onboarding Engineer, Sales/Systems Engineer, Technical Account Manager, or NOC/SOC analyst or equivalent hands-on technical experience managing customer deployments.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="12,1,0">Cloudflare product foundations: working knowledge of Application Security, CDN, Zero Trust/SASE, and Network Services.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="12,2,0">Networking fundamentals: understanding of DNS, TLS/SSL, HTTP/HTTPS, CIDR, NAT, and BGP.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="12,3,0">Web security basics: familiarity with OWASP, WAF rules, OAuth, SAML, MFA, and Zero Trust principles.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="12,4,0">Configuration and integration: hands-on experience with the Cloudflare Dashboard, and comfort with Terraform, API-based configurations, or identity providers such as Okta, Azure AD, and SAML/OIDC integrations.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="12,5,0">Observability: ability to read and interpret Security Events, Logs, cURL outputs, and HAR files; awareness of common causes of 5xx/4xx errors post-onboarding.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="12,6,0">Scripting and APIs: ability to read and debug REST API calls; basic proficiency with Python and Bash.</p> </li> </ul> <p data-path-to-node="13"><strong>Working Style:</strong></p> <ul data-path-to-node="14"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="14,0,0">Customer empathy: explains technical concepts without jargon; calms frustrated customers.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="14,0,0">Structured communication: clear agendas, concise summaries, documented next steps.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="14,2,0">Bias for action: progresses onboarding rather than waiting; knows when to escalate appropriately.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="14,3,0">Curiosity: digs into why something works and learns unfamiliar Cloudflare products quickly.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="14,4,0">Resilience: handles ambiguity, incomplete requirements, and changing priorities.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="14,5,0">Coachability: accepts feedback and improves from every onboarding engagement.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="14,6,0">Time management: juggles a portfolio of onboarding customers and meets committed timelines.</p> </li> </ul> <p data-path-to-node="15"><strong>Communication: </strong></p> <p data-path-to-node="15">Strong written and verbal communication skills. Able to document clearly, summarize concisely, and interact professionally with both technical and non-technical customer contacts. Regulatory and Security Awareness (Nice-to-Haves): Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, SOC 2, or ISO 27001 is a plus.</p> <p data-path-to-node="17"><strong>Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The Good-to-Haves):</strong></p> <ul data-path-to-node="18"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="18,0,0">Cloudflare Certifications: Existing Cloudflare certifications (e.g., Cloudflare Fundamentals, Cloudflare for Teams, or Cloudflare for Developers).</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="18,1,0">Prior Cloudflare Experience: Direct experience onboarding or administering Cloudflare in a production environment.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="18,2,0">Automation Mindset: Familiarity with Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Pulumi) or CI/CD pipelines for configuration management.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="18,3,0">AI-Augmented Workflow: Comfort using AI assistants, LLM-based tools, or scripting to accelerate routine onboarding tasks, log analysis, or documentation.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="18,4,0">Fluency in English is required.</p> </li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. title: Solutions Consultant, Commercial - Nordics
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: Notion is reimagining how enterprise software is sold and the Solutions Consultant is the cornerstone of that model. As a SC, you’ll own the full customer journey: from first meeting through workflow design, commercial close, workflow implementation, expansion & renewal planning. You are the single owner of your accounts, accountable for ensuring what you sell actually gets realized. You’ll build live in front of customers, translate workflow designs into commercial outcomes, and be a trusted partner with genuine continuity across the entire relationship. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Own the full customer lifecycle—new logo, expansion, and renewal—as the single account owner for your book of business, with responsibility for ensuring credits sold translate into credits consumed - Design and build workflow solutions live with customers: the discovery is the demo, not the slide deck—you’ll run discovery, design current-to-future-state workflow architecture, and co-build in Notion with the customer - Partner with BDRs on target account planning and co-own the outbound motion for your book, running direct outreach to priority stakeholders alongside BDR-sourced pipeline - Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path - Guide customers through early implementation with a clear adoption plan and handoff to Outcomes Architects for ongoing multi-workflow expansion - Partner with Outcomes Architects (OA) on onboarding, adoption plans, expansion strategies, and renewal execution—owning the commercial arc while OAs drive day-to-day workflow adoption SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - Experience selling technical products to technical buyers - Technical fluency and genuine comfort building live in software—you can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot in front of a customer without a specialist in the room - Strong discovery and qualification instincts, with the ability to map customer workflows and translate them into commercial outcomes and adoption plans - Experience running complex, multi-stakeholder interactions including procurement, legal, and security review cycles - You can own the room - you operate with agency and urgency to bring new ideas and workflows to our customers and present simple ways to solve complex problems - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools & learning new ways of working NICE TO HAVES: - We are growing our team and looking for contributors of all seniorities.</p></div><p class="wnfdnte" data-pm-slice="1 1 []">Our Tensix team is building custom AI compute cores, RISC-V CPUs, and chiplet-based architectures for datacenter, edge, and automotive AI. description: <p>Principal data strategists at Thoughtworks are experienced consultants who work with clients to create winning data solutions that meet business goals. They play a pivotal role in developing modern data architecture approaches that directly address our clients' key business objectives. Their responsibilities span in-depth reviews of current data and technology strategy, targeted data strategy, guiding clients to unlock the full potential of data, and providing high-level roadmaps.</p> <p>This role entails a mix of advisory responsibilities in data strategy and governance, coupled with a solid delivery-lead role and a breadth of data and AI ecosystem expertise.</p> <p>This is a client-facing, builder's leadership role. You will start with a small, senior team and grow it through technical depth, delivery excellence and thought leadership, rather than inheriting a large organisation to manage. The role is based in Germany and requires regular travel to client sites, up to approximately 50% of your time.</p> <p><strong>Job responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>You will collaborate closely with clients to understand their business ecosystem and goals, and co-create data and technology strategies aligned with their objectives.</li> <li>You will help define a clear vision for the client enterprise to become data-driven and aligned with the overall business strategy.</li> <li>You will consult on complex data programs, providing technical leadership and guidance as a data subject-matter expert.</li> <li>You will lead and interact with clients across various domains, addressing challenging problems, and collaborate with sales to turn them into viable solutions and winning proposals.</li> <li>You will act as a translator between business, data and IT, and communicate data strategy to senior client stakeholders, including C-level.</li> <li>You will own the creation of end-to-end viable data solutions, keeping in mind long-term impacts and overseeing program inceptions for new product development.</li> <li>You will be responsible for formulating data governance strategies addressing security, privacy and compliance requirements.</li> <li>You will enable capability building in data strategy and governance, growing the next generation of data strategists.</li> <li>You will create differentiated assets in data strategy and governance to take to market.</li> <li>You lead through influence rather than headcount: growing capability and raising delivery standards inside the organisation, while building our presence in the market through thought leadership, ecosystem initiatives and client-facing points of view.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Job qualifications</strong></p> <p><strong>Technical Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have extensive experience as a consultant, with a proven track record of creating data strategy and solutions that drive business value.</li> <li>You have solid experience with data platforms and technologies, and can provide advisory and consultative guidance for clients and cross-delivery teams.</li> <li>You have experience engaging with C-level stakeholders to influence and enable the operationalization of an enterprise-wide data strategy.</li> <li>You have demonstrated leadership abilities, with the capacity to lead technical teams and drive projects to successful completion.</li> <li>You are flexible and adaptable across a variety of projects, leveraging technical expertise and leadership to maximise impact.</li> <li>You have a track record of ensuring proper data governance policies, including data lineage, quality checks and classification.</li> <li>You have experience with AI and ML use cases and landscapes and can influence the build of the right solutions to harness insights from data.</li> <li>You have experience building high-level solution frameworks, leveraging paradigms such as data-as-a-product and federated governance where needed.</li> <li>You have professional working proficiency in German (B2 minimum, C1 strongly preferred) and can build consensus with mostly technical stakeholders. Exceptional candidates with outstanding data and AI consulting credentials may be considered where German is not yet at this level.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Consulting and commercial track record</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have worked in a consultancy or professional-services environment within the last five years, driving data and AI engagements end to end (recent examples matter more than historical ones).</li> <li>You can point to data and AI pursuits you helped win and shape within the last three to five years, including deals from around €3M upwards, and you can speak concretely to their commercial shape, trade-offs and delivery.</li> <li>You have grown a practice, capability or go-to-market asset, for example a reusable accelerator taken to market, combining solutioning, sales and delivery with tangible business outcomes.</li> <li>You stay conversant with the technology and hands-on enough in at least one relevant area to earn technical credibility with client and delivery teams, while leading primarily on strategy and advisory.</li> <li>You bring significant hands-on and leadership experience in data and AI (typically 10+ years) and, above all, the appetite to keep building: growing accounts, teams and capability rather than only overseeing them.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Professional Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>You understand the importance of stakeholder management and can easily liaise between clients and other key stakeholders, ensuring buy-in and gaining trust along the way.</li> <li>You are resilient in ambiguous situations and can adapt your role to approach challenges from multiple perspectives.</li> <li>You don't shy away from risks or conflicts, instead you take them on and skillfully manage them.</li> <li>You coach, mentor and motivate others and aspire to influence teammates to take positive action and accountability for their work.</li> <li>You enjoy influencing others and always advocate for technical excellence while being open to change when needed.</li> <li>Cultivating strong partnerships comes naturally to you; you understand how relationship building brings new opportunities to our business.</li> <li>You have professional working proficiency in German (B2 minimum, C1 strongly preferred) and can build consensus with mostly technical stakeholders. Exceptional candidates with outstanding data and AI consulting credentials may be considered where German is not yet at this level.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Other things to know</strong></p> <p><strong>Learning & Development</strong></p> <p>There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. Bring your brilliant expertise and commitment for continuous learning to Thoughtworks. Together, let's be extraordinary.</p> <p><br><br></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p style="text-align: center;"><a href="https://www.thoughtworks.com/careers/ai-policy-for-recruitment">See here our AI policy.</a></p></div> Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Consultant (Strategy & Data/AI Transformation)
description: <h2>Who is Artefact?</h2> <p>Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm dedicated to transforming organisations through data and AI.
